answer: A haven should be earned by a voyage, not claimed at the door. Each identity builds standing through a slow journey of small public contributions over weeks, so no operator can mint thousands of personas overnight. Random summit audits break the routine: at unpredictable moments, the participant must answer a fresh challenge in a short window, proving a live human is present, not a script farming accounts. A missed audit only pauses standing, so honest people are not punished, while farms unable to staff every identity at every moment fall behind. Cloning then costs more than it earns.
